# MindPalace App

**Installing?** Use the one-file installers in `dist/` (generated by
`scripts/package.ps1`): `dist/windows/install.ps1` and `dist/linux/install.sh`,
each with its own README. They ask install folder, data location, hotkey,
window size and autostart, and on Hyprland/Omarchy also wire up window rules
(float by default; your own togglefloating key tiles it like any window).

Tauri 2 + React scratchpad. Frameless acrylic-glass window, always on top, monochrome UI.
The writing pad is the main element: a Medium-style CodeMirror editor with live markdown
styling and VS Code-grade editing (multi-cursor, line operations) — no toolbars, keyboard
only. See [SHORTCUTS.md](SHORTCUTS.md) for every key.

- **Global hotkey**: `Ctrl+Shift+Space` toggles the window (falls back to `Alt+Space` if taken)
- **Close button / Esc**: hides to the system tray (saves first) — quit from the tray menu
- **Tray**: left-click toggles, right-click for Show/Hide + Quit
- **Pad**: autosaves 0.7s after you stop typing; a blank pad becomes a new item on first save,
  title follows the first line. `Ctrl+N` new note, `Ctrl+S` save now.
- **Sidebar**: search (keyword scoring over title/tags/summary/content), type filter, item list;
  click an item to open it in the pad
- **Storage**: dev builds use the shared `../agent/data/palace.json` (same store as the agent
  CLI and the `mindpalace` Claude Code skill); installed builds default to
  `%APPDATA%\MindPalace\palace.json` (Linux: `~/.local/share/MindPalace/`). `MINDPALACE_DATA`
  overrides everywhere — point an installed build at the repo store to keep the skill and app
  on one brain. Reloads on focus.
- **Settings**: optional `config.json` next to palace.json (`MINDPALACE_CONFIG` overrides the
  location): `hotkey`, `fallbackHotkey`, `window: {width, height}`, `autostart`, `theme` — all
  optional, defaults match the hardcoded behavior. The installers write it from your answers.
- **Theme**: follows the OS light/dark setting live (Windows app mode; GTK/Omarchy
  color-scheme on Linux). `"theme": "dark"` or `"light"` in config.json forces one. All colors
  are CSS variables in `src/App.css`; the acrylic tint flips with the theme on Windows.
- **AI (opt-in, privacy-first)**: off by default; nothing ever leaves the app while off.
  The ✦ titlebar button connects the first AI CLI it finds (`claude`, `codex`, `opencode`,
  `ollama` — ollama is fully offline; `"aiModel"` in config.json) or a `"custom"` argv in
  `"aiCommand"`. Commands come from `SKILLS.md` next to palace.json: each `## name` section
  is a `--name` inline command (`--translate` and `--rephrase` ship by default; add your own).
  Only the single line you run a command on is sent — never the whole note or palace.
- **Single instance**: launching the app again toggles the existing window (on Wayland this
  *is* the hotkey mechanism — see LINUX.md)
- **Linux**: supported — build steps, Hyprland rules, and caveats in [LINUX.md](LINUX.md)
- **Images**: `Ctrl+V` an image anywhere in the window — saved as PNG/JPG into the vault,
  thumbnail in the sidebar, full preview in the pad with open / reveal / copy actions
- **Files**: drag & drop onto the window — copied into the vault (original kept), shown with
  extension chip and size; open / reveal from the preview pane
- **Vault**: `../agent/data/vault/` next to palace.json; item content stores the relative path
- **Autostart**: enabled only in release builds.

```powershell
cd app
npm install
npm run tauri dev     # dev run (first Rust build takes a while)
npm run tauri build   # installer + exe under src-tauri/target/release
```

Phase 2 next: clipboard image paste and file drag-drop into a vault folder (see ../PLAN.md).
